notes.title: 1.3.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 🙂

This update is a lot smaller than the previous one (1.3.1), but very relevant nonetheless. Most of the changes are bug fixes, however there’s quite a big addition to gamepad users here: full analog support. 🎮

Before this update you could only move the main character in 8 fixed directions, which can lead to some very unpredictable results if you’re using an analog stick (which many people do use), so after a lot of try and error I can finally announce that it’s now possible to walk in absolutely any direction by playing the game with a supported gamepad (Xbox, PS4, Switch, etc). If you enjoy using a gamepad I highly recommend you to give Rabisco another try now with this very simple, but cool update. 🎮

This was probably the biggest highlight in the update, but I’ll list the rest of the changes down below. 📒


 Fixed a bug where conveyor belts could move the main character in incorrect directions.
 Added the game version to the window title.
 Fixed a bug where the main character could play the wrong animation after finishing a level without any remaining stamina.
 Fixed a bug where the main character could enter sleeping mode while using the eye statue.
 Merged all three robots from the final level into a single robot thanks to the new dialog system.
 Fixed a few english punctuation issues during cutscenes.
 Made a few balancing changes to the way the peanut butter mechanic works in the final levels.


Well, thank you very much for playing Rabisco, I really appreciate the fact that you gave one of my games a chance! Have a great one. ✨

Edit 001: Apparently there’s an issue with the Greenworks features, it’s not triggering achievement anymore. I’ll start to investigate this problem and release a patch as soon as possible. 💻

Edit 002: I know it's taking quite a long time to fix the Greenworks issue (17 days already), but unfortunately I rely on a third party developer to change the base API and he seems to be a little bit busy at the moment. However, he should be back working on it next week, so everyone can get their achievements back! I'm sorry for this inconvenience, thank you all for your amazing support and patience. 💕
GitHub issue link in case anyone want to follow our progress: https://github.com/Scirra/Construct-3-bugs/issues/4079

Edit 003: Everything is fixed! For further information about this topic, please take a look at the 1.3.5 update patch notes. 🎮

notes.title: 1.3.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 😊

I’ve been working with some amazing people from another company (can’t really mention their name right now because of our NDA contract) in order to bring Rabisco to more platforms, to do that, we needed to update quite a lot of stuff in the original project, by adding new features and improving the old ones. Since most of the work is already done, there was literally no reason for me to not release this content as a free update for you all. I’ll list the changes below. 🎮

Please, let me know if you have any issues with this update, so I can fix it as soon as possible! 💻


 Checkpoints - I really want to make my games more accessible, so hardcore players can show their skills by making amazing speedruns, while more casual players can simply have some fun without the frustration of restarting an entire level again because the final segment is too hard or something like that.
 Hard mode - Don't worry, the checkpoints are completely optional and you can toggle them off in the hub world, by interacting with the new skull shrine.
 New font - The old font relied a lot on the users operational system and on which fonts they had installed in their computer, it could lead to some very weird results in virtual machines for example, so I included a bitmap font in the project files, which will be automatically detected and used by the game, fixing many issues from older versions while also being more readable.
 New achievements - There are two new achievements as well, you can get one of them by defeating the final boss and the other by activating the hard mode shrine for the first time.
 New timer - I know some players love to make speedruns, so I added a new timer to the game that will properly format the text like the standard "00 : 28 : 34" instead of just "1714 seconds". This is more of a quality of life improvement.
 Splash screen - I added the lovely Green Dinosaur Games logo as a splash screen before the game actually starts, it's a small touch, but definitely helps to show the player who's the studio behind the game in a more memorable way.
 Bug fixes - There were some very small bugs in the game that I personally never noticed, at least not before I play tested it for days like I did recently. Well, every single bug I was able to find was absolutely fixed. But, if you ever find anything else that looks out of place just let me know, please.


Well, thank you very much for playing Rabisco, I really appreciate the fact that you gave one of my games a chance! Have a great one. ✨

BTW, your in-game progress won't be lost! Everything should stay in place. 💾

notes.title: 1.1.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Here we are with another small update containing some definitive and temporary fixes for recently discovered bugs.

You can now press F12 to take screenshots without being bothered by the NW.js development tools, that's a definitive fix.

However, there's a problem where weaker PCs can suffer to run the game if there are too many instances of the same audio clip being played at the same time, so I disabled a few of those sound effects temporally in order to develop a new audio system without ruining the experience for a few player in the mean time.

The disabled sounds effects are:

 Moving spikes swing
 Cannon shot
 Laser gun break
 Flame thrower burst
 Pulse beam charge

I'll introduce a new audio system in the near future, so these audio clips will be back.

The last thing I would like to mention is the "Time to sleep", I noticed that the main character was entering the "Sleeping" animation very fast, so I changed the "Time to sleep" from 10 seconds to 30 seconds, so it shouldn't trigger very frequently.

That's it for now. Thank you very very much for your patience and for playing Rabisco! I really hope all of you are enjoying it. ːpinkneonheartː
